roms.name: GrapheneOS

risk.why: Official GrapheneOS project build with public source, signed updates and verified boot. Device support and feature states are documented upstream; ROMinit has not hardware-tested this tablet.

rating.note: Upstream-documented support, checked 21 October 2026; not hardware-tested by ROMinit. USB networking, USB OTG, wired video output and GPS are marked working at the owner’s direction; these four have not been independently verified by ROMinit. SD card, NFC, cellular service, camera flash, IR, proximity sensor, vibration motor and barometer are absent. Banking-app compatibility varies; optional sandboxed Google Play may be needed.

roms.notes: Full graphical Android 17 interface with a home screen, touch navigation, Android apps, camera and Vanadium browser. Sandboxed Google Play is optional. Official Pixel Tablet release; hardware support below follows upstream documentation, not a ROMinit hardware test.

screenshots.caption: GrapheneOS Android 17 UI: home screen and default apps (zoom). Illustrative phone screenshot; tablet layout differs and exact build 2026101600 is not verified. GrapheneOS developers, MIT.

external.why: ROMinit has no pinned GrapheneOS image files or flash stages; use the project's official WebUSB installer.

requirements: OEM unlocking must be available and enabled in the stock OS; carrier restrictions can prevent bootloader unlocking.
Back up data first: unlocking, installing GrapheneOS and relocking the bootloader each erase user data.
Follow the installer through bootloader relocking, then verify the Pixel Tablet boot key hash: `94df136e6c6aa08dc26580af46f36419b5f9baf46039db076f5295b91aaff230`.
Use GrapheneOS's supported WebUSB browser and operating system with a direct USB connection; avoid hubs and virtual machines.
Disconnect the Pixel Tablet from its Charging Speaker Dock before USB flashing.
